description: End-to-end test script using Playwright to validate race condition prevention in booking system, including setup, mocking, concurrent booking simulation, and result analysis.

classes.name: TeamWithMetadata
classes.description: Type combining Team with additional metadata schema information.

methods.name: setupTeamWithRoundRobin
methods.description: Sets up a team with round-robin scheduling and associated entities.

methods.name: setupGoogleCalendarCredentials
methods.description: Creates Google Calendar credentials for team members in the database.

methods.name: createIdenticalBookingHistories
methods.description: Creates multiple bookings with identical timestamps for testing race conditions.

methods.name: getDynamicBookingDate
methods.description: Navigates to booking page and selects a date for testing.

methods.name: mockGoogleCalendarAPI
methods.description: Mocks Google Calendar API responses to simulate busy schedules.

methods.name: performConcurrentBookings
methods.description: Simulates concurrent booking requests using multiple browser contexts.

methods.name: analyzeBookingResults
methods.description: Analyzes booking responses and database state to determine if race conditions are prevented.
